svg.text: The smallest possible rights: Grafana may only read
Concept 3 · the database account grafana_reader from grafana/grafana-user.sql · two layers of guards
used by the backend and the migrations
a new account, only for Grafana
its password isn't written in a file: typed with \password grafana_reader in psql
Layer 2: grants per table and per column
GRANT SELECT only on the tables that
The smarthome database as grafana_reader sees it
device_id, kind, name, location, lat, lng, status,
closed: key_hash, key_created_at (the Module 21 device keys)
Tried in psql as grafana_reader (exact texts, the author's lab)
ERROR: permission denied for table devices
ERROR: permission denied for table devices
ERROR: permission denied for table users
ERROR: permission denied for table sessions
ERROR: cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction
ERROR: cannot execute DROP TABLE in a read-only transaction
Because the rights are per column, panel queries always name their columns (never SELECT *). Data source: Max open 4, because this account may hold at most 5 connections.
The same pattern as the backend's guard (Module 20) and the broker ACL (Module 21): every user gets only what it needs.
